fine_lines.title: good at vs good
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good at + نشاط تعني ماهر فيه (I'm good at drawing). good وحدها صفة تعني جيد (This is good).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Good at" + activity = able to do it well. "Good" alone = nice, fine.

fine_lines.title: can vs good at
fine_lines.explanation_ar: can تعني أستطيع (I can play). good at تعني أنني ماهر فيه. يمكن أن تستطيع شيئًا لكنك لست ماهرًا: I can play a little, but I'm not very good.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Can" = able to. "Good at" = do it well. You can do something but not be good at it.

examples.sentence: I can play football a little.
But I am not very good at football.

expressions.phrase: It is a beautiful day today.
expressions.meaning_en: Start small talk about the weather.
expressions.example: It is a beautiful day today. Let's go out.
Warm and sunny! I love this weather.

expressions.phrase: Are you good at football? — Not really.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل أنت ماهر في كرة القدم؟ — ليس كثيرًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about a skill and answer softly.
expressions.example: Are you good at math? Not really.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you have a small skill.
expressions.example: I can speak English a little.
I'm not good at swimming. That's okay.
What are you good at? I'm good at drawing.
You want to speak English better? You can practice with me.
Don't worry. Maybe you just need practice.
This is hard? I can help you.

grammar.title: be good at + noun / verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: نقول I am good at + اسم (football, English) أو فعل بـ ing (drawing, cooking). والنفي: I am not good at swimming. والسؤال: Are you good at...? / What are you good at?
grammar.explanation_en: be good at + noun or verb-ing. Negative: I'm not good at... Question: Are you good at...?
examples: I am not good at swimming.

grammar.title: can + verb for ability
grammar.explanation_ar: can + الفعل في أصله للقدرة: I can cook pasta. والنفي can't. ولا نضيف s مع he/she: She can draw.
grammar.explanation_en: can + base verb for ability. Negative: can't. No -s: she can draw.
examples: I can cook pasta, rice, and soup.

grammar.title: Adverbs: a little, very
grammar.explanation_ar: a little تعني قليلًا، و very تعني جدًا: I can play a little. I am not very good.
grammar.explanation_en: a little = a small amount; very = a lot.
examples: But I am not very good.
She is very good at cooking.
